# Business Travel Booking

All business travel is booked through Concur, the company's travel and expense tool. Flights
should be booked at least two weeks in advance when possible to keep costs down; economy class
is standard for flights under six hours.

The company has a preferred airline partner for domestic routes, which unlocks discounted
fares and priority boarding when booked through Concur directly rather than an outside site.
Hotel bookings above the nightly rate cap require manager approval before the trip.

Keep all receipts from the trip even though Concur pulls itemized folios automatically for
approved hotel chains; the automatic pull occasionally misses incidental charges.
